Additionally, WDF provides users of our Platform with an interface, known as a semantic layer, that helps users interpret and use data to complete tasks without requiring technical knowledge of underlying database structures. With these capabilities, WDF enables organizations to connect, understand and act on any data source, establishing a unified data foundation that supports AI agents, automation and analytics, all of which enhance workflow performance.
annotation_rationale: AI-ready data fabric supports AI agents; supporting data foundation is not a separate AI application.
